newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bourse to launch new 100-share index Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bourse to launch new 100-share index Monday.

text.p: South America's biggest bolsa will launch a new 100-share index Monday, providing stock-watchers with a new instrument to analyze the behavior of Brazilian shares, officials said.

The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said in a statement the new IBX or Brazil Index will take as its historical and statistical base 1995's last session and include the bolsa's most representative shares according to trade and volatility.
"A portfolio has been put together based on the market value of the companies," the statement said. The portfolio will be revised every four months, it said.
The index will only be updated once a day at the end of trading.
The new index will be a broader measure of the bolsa's performance than the existing Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares and Electrical Energy Index of nine most-liquid power shares.
According to the bolsa, the IBX rose 42.9 percent in 1996's first 11 months while the Bovespa index rose 55 percent in the January-November period.
